scopedPipelineIds.description: HEL-369: optional pipeline-id allow-list. Absent (default) means an unscoped, full-access PAT. When present, must be non-empty; each id must be a pipeline the caller owns or has editor access to (viewer-only access is rejected -- a viewer can never trigger a run). A scoped token authenticates ONLY POST /api/hooks/run, confined to these pipeline ids.
